parsed.why: National seat under the parent's passport/entry regime, plus a legislature-imposed facilities ban it cannot locally repeal and arrests of trans protesters there; low-risk listing is fragile under national override.

Adds a birth-sex facilities ban with a public reporting form enabling citizen-initiated outing, flag ban, dorm and care bans, plus hostile national layer; only partial protections and a documentary defence unavailable to visitors.

No facilities ban, decade-old gender-identity discrimination and hate-crime coverage, easy marker change; but only 'refrains from targeting' rather than protective, and the parent's document/entry regime still applies fully.

Constitutional gender-identity protection, public-accommodations coverage, X markers, care mandates and a hate-crime hotline; assessed shortfalls on healthcare equity and incarceration, plus unknown facilities status and the parent's document regime.

Most-protective tier: public-accommodations ban covering hotels/services, hate-crime penalties since 1999, panic-defence repeal, gender-neutral single-user bathrooms, shield laws protect travelling families; tempered only by the shared national document/entry regime.
